description.narrative: As part of its core activities, the Digital Transformation Technical Assistance Facility (TAF) will engage DAI under a technical assistance (TA) framework agreement to support the digital transformation journey of FMO’s customers participating in the DFC-MASSIF co-investment facility by addressing knowledge gaps and limitations of their current Information Technology (IT) systems, product offer, and corporate strategy. The aim of this TA under the framework agreement (“the project”) is to provide advisory services and support the design and implementation of digital strategies that enhance organizational processes, improve customer experiences, and achieve sustainable growth.
